//go:build (linux && amd64) || (darwin && arm64)

package runtime

import "unsafe"

type GomadNativePollState struct {
	Registered      bool
	Descriptor      uintptr
	Token           uint64
	Sequence        uintptr
	Reader          uintptr
	Writer          uintptr
	ReaderCommitted bool
	WriterCommitted bool
	HostWaiters     uint32
}

func GomadNativePollSnapshot(fd uintptr) GomadNativePollState {
	state := GomadNativePollState{HostWaiters: netpollWaiters.Load()}
	if fd < gomadVirtualFDBase || fd >= gomadVirtualFDBase+gomadVirtualFDCount {
		return state
	}
	lock(&pollcache.lock)
	slot := &gomadVirtualPoll[fd-gomadVirtualFDBase]
	if pd := slot.pd; pd != nil {
		state.Registered = true
		state.Descriptor = uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(pd))
		state.Token, state.Sequence = slot.token, pd.fdseq.Load()
		state.Reader, state.Writer = pd.rg.Load(), pd.wg.Load()
		if state.Reader > pdWait {
			state.ReaderCommitted = readgstatus((*g)(unsafe.Pointer(state.Reader)))&^_Gscan == _Gwaiting
		}
		if state.Writer > pdWait {
			state.WriterCommitted = readgstatus((*g)(unsafe.Pointer(state.Writer)))&^_Gscan == _Gwaiting
		}
	}
	unlock(&pollcache.lock)
	return state
}

func GomadNativePublish(fd uintptr, token uint64, mode int32) {
	gomadVirtualReady(fd, token, mode)
}
